We need to determine statutory charge(s) based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: a state employee (public servant) misappropriated social security contributions (public funds) of 1,332,700 RMB, used to purchase bank financial product, earned interest 4,739.64 RMB, interest recovered. He returned principal, interest seized. He voluntarily surrendered and confessed (self-surrender). So charge: "挪用公款罪" (Embezzlement of public funds) under Article 384 of Criminal Law (public officials misusing public funds). Also possibly "职务侵占罪"? Actually for state employees, misappropriation of public funds is "挪用公款罪". The amount is "数额较大" (over 100,000). So charge: 挪用公款罪. Also maybe "受贿"? No, not receiving bribe. So single charge.

Thus answer format: [罪名]挪用公款罪<eoa>
